request.spec:
An OPEN or PENDING claim can be held and released with a toggle on the claim (CLAIM_HELD and
CLAIM_RELEASED naming the claim; any other status is refused with an error on the claim). A held
claim leaves every live total exactly as a held person's claims do (a figure bound by a statement
stays in). Show held yes/no on the claim.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
An OPEN or PENDING claim can be held and released with a toggle on the claim (CLAIM_HELD and
CLAIM_RELEASED naming the claim; any other status is refused with an error on the claim). A held
claim leaves every live total exactly as a held person's claims do (a figure bound by a statement
stays in). Show held yes/no on the claim.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored
data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
Claims can now be held and released, and all four tests in `bin/e2e` pass.

- **Toggle:** each claim has a Hold/Release button (`claim-hold`) and shows held yes/no (`claim-held`). It works on OPEN or PENDING claims only. Any other status is refused with `claim-error` and nothing is stored or audited.
- **Audit:** each press writes `CLAIM_HELD` or `CLAIM_RELEASED` with the claim's person, amount, date and number. A `ROLLUP`/`TOTALS` line follows only when the totals actually move.
- **Totals:** a held claim counts exactly like one in a held person's hold. An open claim that no statement binds drops out of every live total. A bound one stays in at its stated figure, and settled ones always count. I added the held check to the existing hold rule in `Person.countsLive`/`countsAtEndOf`, the dated-statement check in `StatementService`, and the front end's `leftOut` in `people.ts`, so screen and server stay in step.
- **Stored data:** a new migration, `V99__claim_held.sql`, adds a `held` column to claims. I also copy the flag when a sheet is cloned, which the tests don't check.

Holding a claim is open to any signed-in user; only waiving a late charge is limited to stewards. A held claim also stays marked held if it's later settled or voided. The tests expect that for a settled claim; for a voided one the request didn't say, so I left it as is.
